_readme: Era overlay for the macroplaza-mall space: what was different in March 1982, the month the mall opened as Pasadena Town Square Mall. Read by tools/space_from_osm.py --era=1982 together with macroplaza-mall.osm.json (today's geometry). Everything here carries its source; nothing is invented. canon: archive-reconstruction — the archive itself begins in 1999, so this is a reconstruction from published histories, not from our own record.
label: Grand opening, March 1982
name: Pasadena Town Square Mall
note: The year is established (1982); the exact grand-opening day is NOT on record in any source reached on 2026-09-03 — Wikipedia's text says 'March 1962' but describes a sale 'a little more than a year after opening' that took place in 1983, so its year is a typo for 1982. When a dated source (a Houston Chronicle or Pasadena Citizen page) names the day, set `date` and `date_precision: day` here and regenerate.

sources.supports: opened 1982; anchors Foley's, Palais Royal, Joske's (later Dillard's); 1980s stores
sources.quote: Pasadena Town Square opened in 1982 in Houston's blue-collar, southeast suburb of Pasadena.

sources.supports: developer Federated Stores Realty, attached to an existing Foley's; anchors; JMB sale; renamings 2016 and 2018; its '1962' is inconsistent with its own 1983 sale sentence
sources.quote: Developed by Federated Stores Realty ... and attached to an existing Foley's Department store, it opened in March 1962 [sic].

sources.supports: 1982 opening (via search summary; page itself returned 403 to this session)

examine.label: Mall directory, 1982
text: PASADENA TOWN SQUARE MALL — opened March 1982.
Some of the stores of the decade: Walgreens, Sound Warehouse, Chess King, Spencer Gifts, B. Dalton, Waldenbooks, Casual Corner, Circus World.
Where each one stood inside the mall is not on record. This directory is a reconstruction from published histories.
